name: thread-pulse
description: Makes running tool calls visible: live cards for every shell command with output as it runs (Command Watch), a status line for long calls, and a live line in Claude project thread checklists.

thresholdSeconds.title: Show a call after (seconds)
thresholdSeconds.description: A tool call that runs longer than this is shown as still running.

warnMinutes.title: Warn after (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: A tool call that runs longer than this is marked as possibly stuck.

localWatch.title: Local Command Watch
localWatch.description: Write each shell command and its live output to ~/.claude/command-watch for the Command Watch page.

serveWatch.title: Serve the Command Watch page
serveWatch.description: Start the page server (python3, 127.0.0.1 only) from the first session that finds the port free.

watchPort.title: Command Watch port
watchPort.description: Port of the Command Watch page on 127.0.0.1.
